From grounded perception to scientific reasoning. Follow a route, choose an experiment, and connect it to a method for improvement.

Grounded perception

↗02 / EXPLORE

INHERITANCE

What carries forward?

Can a useful capability survive across versions, tasks, or models? Trace the memory, skills, and code that make reuse possible.

↗ 02
EVOLUTIONARY SEARCH

Which branches matter?

↗ 03
RECURSIVE IMPROVEMENT

Can improvement improve?

Do descendants become better at producing useful changes? Separate an editable improver from evidence of greater improvement ability.
